notes: Two closely related SKUs exist: the original "SEVEN Generator" (MU-GEN-SEVEN, HDMI 2.1 feature-set on older hardware, reported 12V/3A locking barrel supply) and the current "8K SEVEN" / SEVEN-G8K (MU-GEN-SEVEN-G8K, full 8K/40Gbps HDMI 2.1, reported 12V/5A locking barrel supply). Spec text is drawn primarily from the current 8K SEVEN-G8K model, which "SEVEN-G" commonly refers to in current AVPro Global/Murideo materials — confirm exact SKU/revision before quoting exact wattage. Port list cross-confirmed between the manufacturer page (avproglobal.com, formerly murideo.com/seven-g.html, 301-redirected) and Markertek's spec table, which agree closely. Two items required judgment calls: (1) the DB25 "Expansion Decoder" port has no matching connector id in the allowed list — mapped to dc-barrel only as a placeholder; it is actually a DB25 D-sub connector and should be treated as unconfirmed/needs a better-fitting id if one becomes available; (2) the microphone input is physically a mini-XLR (3-pin) connector, mapped to the standard xlr3 id since no "mini-XLR" variant exists in the allowed list. HDMI grade (2.1) and USB grade (usb-5g, i.e. "USB 3.0" branding) are taken from marketing copy ("HDMI 2.1 compliant, 40Gbps FRL", "USB 3.0") rather than a formal certified compliance statement, so these are inferred/medium-confidence. No rack-mount option exists; this is a handheld/desktop field test instrument (~20x16x10 in per one retailer, unverified), so rackUnits omitted. Ethernet port speed (100M/1G) is not stated in any source and is left ungraded.
